title: Kafka east failover: controller-leader move
description: Stops kafka.service on the controller-quorum leader, polls a survivor for re-election (RTO), then restarts + rejoins. Complements the cross-region MM2 DR.

prerequisites.smokeGate: nexus-infra-kafka smoke-0.H.2 + smoke-0.H.5 ALL GREEN; role-overlay-kafka-acl-authorizer applied

observe.what: leader moves to a new broker, RTO ~4.5s, old leader rejoins

whatProves: failover proves a controlled KRaft controller-leader election + recovery.
